_about: What verify/from-json.js cannot fill mechanically for big-demons-baby, written by hand and read by it on every run (from-json.js --write gives the same data.js again). The list was first imported from New Recruit’s PDF (verify/import-nr.js); these are the values data.js had then that its JSON export and GW’s pages do not give, each as data.js showed it and as its review signed it off: source (the day the PDF was exported; the export has none), units.<id>: notes (GW’s words under a fixed source label, an FAQ or a Designer’s Note under an ability), short (the short name), kwOnly and partialRules (which model has a keyword or a core ability only some models of the unit have, where GW’s pages do not say it mechanically).

source.why: the day New Recruit’s PDF of this list was exported (verify/sources/nr/big-demons-baby.txt), from which the list was first imported; the JSON export carries no date

daemon-prince-of-khorne.why: short: the name the unit screen and the lists show for the Daemon Prince of Khorne, as data.js has always shown it (GW's datasheet name is long for a phone line).
